citations.claim: WORKSPACE_CONFIG enumerates auction, workout, reading, project, and personal but not the Knowledge Hub.
The Knowledge Hub mounts its production renderer through ProdigyHubLoader with the loader mount context.
mountKnowledgeExplorer creates its default brief service with empty provider/config adapters when callers omit briefService.
Brief recovery uses deterministic Korean statusCopy output and renders a retry action for cancelled or fallback state without identifying a provider-gated state.
hydrateSelectedAsset tracks loading and generic error state by requestId and selected asset path while suppressing stale results.
appendHydrationSection renders generic hydration error copy asking the user to reselect, with no action control in the generated detail section.
mountKnowledgeAuthoringActions presents paired '+ 지식 작성' and '+ 문헌노트 작성' controls with copy distinguishing thought/experience from source-backed material.

items.observed_problem: The launcher registry omits the existing Knowledge Hub, so the user-facing launcher cannot expose the same workspace inventory as direct HUB navigation.
items.expected_effect: Add an explicitly reviewed Knowledge launcher card or document the intentional exclusion, keeping navigation-only behavior and the existing Knowledge route identity.

items.observed_problem: The Explorer can construct a deterministic brief with empty provider/config adapters and presents the same generic fallback copy when an AI provider is unavailable; the provider-gated state is not an explicit user-facing status.
items.expected_effect: Expose a safe Korean provider-unavailable state and deterministic-only explanation while retaining the explicit AI request action, no raw provider reason, and no implicit provider call.

items.observed_problem: A body hydration failure is safely reduced to a generic error state and asks the user to reselect the note, but the detail surface has no explicit retry action tied to the selected revision.
items.expected_effect: Offer a revision-bound retry beside the existing error copy, preserve stale-result suppression and zero writes, and keep the selected read surface mounted.

items.observed_problem: The entry surface presents direct knowledge writing and material collection as equal actions without a context cue for a first-time user deciding which path preserves evidence provenance.
items.expected_effect: Add concise, user-reviewed guidance distinguishing direct authoring from evidence-backed material capture without auto-selecting a path or changing approval gates.
